title: Finishing Lower-Leg Stroking
summary: Long light passes over the lower leg gradually reduce intensity.
startingPosition: The leg and foot are supported.
instructions: Begin near the top of the foot.
Glide upward over lower-leg soft tissue.
direction: From the foot upward over lower-leg soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
